item.title: Week 1 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 08/08/2026 - 15/08/2026

Week 1 Objectives:

  • Create and secure an AWS account.
  • Become familiar with the main AWS service categories and the AWS Management Console.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
08/08/2026 Create the AWS account and complete the initial account setup. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
10/08/2026 Configure basic account security and review the Management Console. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
12/08/2026 Explore the main AWS service categories: compute, storage, database, networking, and security. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
15/08/2026 Summarize the purpose of the services studied during the week. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 1 Achievements:

  • Created an AWS account and learned how to navigate the AWS Management Console.
  • Built an initial overview of the AWS service ecosystem and the role of each major service group.

item.title: Week 2 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 17/08/2026 - 22/08/2026

Week 2 Objectives:

  • Understand identity and access management with AWS IAM.
  • Practice assigning permissions through groups, users, policies, and roles.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
17/08/2026 Study IAM users, groups, policies, and the principle of least privilege. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
18/08/2026 Create an IAM Group and attach an appropriate IAM Policy. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
19/08/2026 Create IAM Users and assign permissions through the group. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
20/08/2026 Configure an IAM Role and practice the Switch Role process. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
22/08/2026 Compare the privileges and recommended use of the Root User and IAM User. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 2 Achievements:

  • Created and managed IAM identities with group-based permissions.
  • Practiced role switching and understood why daily work should use IAM identities instead of the Root User.

item.title: Week 3 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 24/08/2026 - 29/08/2026

Week 3 Objectives:

  • Monitor AWS spending with AWS Budgets.
  • Set cost alerts and identify ways to control cloud resource usage.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
24/08/2026 Study AWS Budgets and the available budget templates. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
25/08/2026 Create a Monthly Cost Budget for the AWS account. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
27/08/2026 Configure notifications when actual or forecast costs reach the defined thresholds. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
29/08/2026 Review cost optimization practices and unused-resource control. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 3 Achievements:

  • Deployed a monthly budget and configured automatic cost alerts.
  • Understood how budgets and regular resource reviews reduce the risk of unexpected cloud charges.

item.title: Week 4 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 31/08/2026 - 05/09/2026

Week 4 Objectives:

  • Deploy an Amazon EC2 virtual server and secure its network access.
  • Practice EBS backup and connect an EC2 application to Amazon RDS.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
31/08/2026 Study EC2 instance components and launch a virtual server. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
01/09/2026 Configure a Security Group to allow only necessary inbound traffic. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
03/09/2026 Create and review an EBS Snapshot for data backup. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
04/09/2026 Study Amazon RDS and deploy a relational database instance. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
05/09/2026 Configure a secure database connection from the EC2 server and verify connectivity. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 4 Achievements:

  • Launched and secured an EC2 instance and created an EBS backup snapshot.
  • Deployed an RDS database and verified a controlled connection from the application server.

item.title: Week 5 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 07/09/2026 - 12/09/2026

Week 5 Objectives:

  • Understand Auto Scaling, Manual Scaling, and basic serverless architecture.
  • Attend FCAJ Community Day and record the main lessons.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
07/09/2026 Study the purpose and operating model of Auto Scaling. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
08/09/2026 Practice Manual Scaling by increasing and decreasing server capacity. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
09/09/2026 Test system behavior after capacity changes and compare manual and automatic scaling. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
11/09/2026 Research the basic characteristics and benefits of AWS serverless architecture. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
12/09/2026 Attend FCAJ Community Day and summarize the technical knowledge shared at the event.

Week 5 Achievements:

  • Understood the difference between manual capacity changes and automated scaling.
  • Built a basic serverless mindset and gained practical perspectives from FCAJ Community Day.

item.title: Week 6 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 14/09/2026 - 19/09/2026

Week 6 Objectives:

  • Deploy source code with AWS Lambda and expose functionality through API Gateway.
  • Attend Meet Up 19/09 and summarize the speaker sessions.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
14/09/2026 Review the AWS Lambda execution model and function configuration. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
15/09/2026 Create and deploy a Lambda function from source code. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
16/09/2026 Configure Amazon API Gateway as an endpoint for the Lambda function. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
18/09/2026 Test requests, review responses, and correct configuration errors. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
19/09/2026 Attend Meet Up 19/09 and document the lessons from the presentations.

Week 6 Achievements:

  • Deployed a Lambda function and invoked it through an API Gateway endpoint.
  • Improved technical and professional knowledge through the Meet Up 19/09 presentations.

item.title: Week 7 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 21/09/2026 - 26/09/2026

Week 7 Objectives:

  • Understand application containerization on AWS.
  • Practice managing and deploying cloud container services.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
21/09/2026 Study container concepts and compare containers with virtual machines. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
22/09/2026 Review the AWS services used to store and run container images. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
23/09/2026 Prepare a simple application container and its runtime configuration. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
25/09/2026 Practice deploying and managing the containerized application on AWS. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
26/09/2026 Verify the deployment and clean up the lab resources. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 7 Achievements:

  • Understood the advantages and limitations of containerized workloads.
  • Practiced the basic workflow for packaging, deploying, and managing a container application on AWS.

item.title: Week 8 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 28/09/2026 - 03/10/2026

Week 8 Objectives:

  • Learn AWS monitoring and system management practices.
  • Explore log filtering, infrastructure health monitoring, and AWS storage services.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
28/09/2026 Study monitoring concepts, metrics, logs, and alarms. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
29/09/2026 Review AWS tools for observing and managing infrastructure. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
30/09/2026 Create log filters to identify important operational events. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
02/10/2026 Monitor infrastructure health and review the collected information. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
03/10/2026 Research AWS storage options and compare their common use cases. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 8 Achievements:

  • Learned how metrics, logs, filters, and alarms support infrastructure monitoring.
  • Developed a clearer understanding of AWS storage choices for different data requirements.

item.title: Week 9 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 05/10/2026 - 10/10/2026

Week 9 Objectives:

  • Apply cost optimization practices and review actual resource usage.
  • Understand backup and recovery and configure an automated backup plan.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
05/10/2026 Study the main AWS cost optimization principles. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
06/10/2026 Measure resource utilization and review the current budget. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
07/10/2026 Identify idle or oversized resources and propose adjustments. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
09/10/2026 Study backup, restore, retention, and recovery concepts. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
10/10/2026 Configure and verify an automated backup plan for the system. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Week 9 Achievements:

  • Reviewed budget and utilization data to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Created an automated backup plan and understood the basic recovery workflow.

item.title: Week 10 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 12/10/2026 - 17/10/2026

Week 10 Objectives:

  • Explore migration solutions and advanced networking architecture on AWS.
  • Attend FCAJ Community Day and prepare an idea for the group project.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
12/10/2026 Study common approaches for migrating data and infrastructure to AWS. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
13/10/2026 Research advanced networking components and connectivity patterns. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
14/10/2026 Review security and availability considerations for migration and networking. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
16/10/2026 Discuss practical problems and develop an initial group-project idea. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
17/10/2026 Attend FCAJ Community Day and refine the project idea using lessons from the event.

Week 10 Achievements:

  • Built an overview of AWS migration and advanced networking considerations.
  • Defined an initial direction for the group project and gained additional insights from FCAJ Community Day.

item.title: Week 11 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 19/10/2026 - 24/10/2026

Week 11 Objectives:

  • Develop the group project according to the agreed idea.
  • Compare completed work with the project’s objectives and adjust the implementation.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
19/10/2026 Confirm the project scope, expected outcome, and division of responsibilities.
20/10/2026 Prepare the project structure and implement the assigned components.
21/10/2026 Integrate the team members’ work and perform functional testing.
23/10/2026 Review progress, identify unfinished requirements, and correct issues.
24/10/2026 Compare the current result with the original objectives and prepare the remaining task list.

Week 11 Achievements:

  • Completed the main implementation tasks assigned within the group project.
  • Evaluated the project against its objectives and identified the work required for final completion.

item.title: Week 12 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 26/10/2026 - 31/10/2026

Week 12 Objectives:

  • Complete, test, and finalize the group project.
  • Write the internship report and publish the supporting worklog website.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
26/10/2026 Complete the remaining group-project features and integrate the final version.
27/10/2026 Test the project, correct issues, and confirm that the result meets the agreed objectives.
28/10/2026 Organize evidence, technical notes, and progress records for the internship report.
30/10/2026 Write and review the 12-week internship report in Vietnamese and English.
31/10/2026 Build the Hugo website, push the source to GitHub, and verify the Netlify deployment.

Week 12 Achievements:

  • Completed the group project and verified the final result against the project objectives.
  • Finished the internship report and organized the progress of all 12 weeks.
  • Published the Hugo worklog through GitHub and Netlify and confirmed that the latest content was available online.
